grades.lower_bound_mechanism: cofactor/defect-entry lemma (bounds each essential prime at entry; finiteness left open)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: residue-class periodicity: L = product of essential primes, T = count in window, from n = 1
grades.notes: Steps 1-3 rigorously prove the characterization (C), unconditionally: sequence is the increasing enumeration of the valid set V. Step 4 gives a complete periodicity assembly (P) with explicit L, T, from n=1, but conditional on finitely many essential primes. (F) finiteness is explicitly the open crux: only a proved per-prime entry bound, conjecture Q<=a_1, and computations. No false lemma relied upon.
